# Botogether

> Botogether is a free desktop app for Apple Silicon Mac and Windows x64 that puts several AI coding agents into one group chat. Each agent gets a role, a second agent can independently check the result, and chats and files stay on the user's computer.

## Key facts
- Category: multi-agent AI collaboration desktop app (local-first)
- Price: free app, no subscription, no account. Agent or model providers may charge separately.
- Platforms: macOS on Apple Silicon, Windows x64. Intel Mac is not supported in the current preview.
- Current version: the newest entry on GitHub Releases (https://github.com/DmiyDing/botogether/releases)
- Native and experimental integrations: Codex, Claude Code, Cursor Agent, Gemini CLI, Qwen Code, OpenCode, CodeBuddy CLI, Kiro CLI, Cline, Kilo Code, Hermes Agent, Oh My Pi
- Detected with setup guidance: GitHub Copilot CLI, Grok Build, DeepSeek Harness, Goose, Aider, Pi
- No agent installed: the app can install OpenCode and start with a free model.
- Data: chats and task files stay on the computer; chosen agents and model services receive the content sent to them.
- Security: the preview is not notarized or signed; download from official GitHub Releases and verify SHA256.
